title: Take A Tour of SMU's City Campus
description:
Singapore Management University (SMU) is Singapore’s first and only autonomous university located in the heart of the central business district, and the cultural and civic precinct. Join our undergraduate ambassadors as they take you around our city campus and introduce you to their favourite spots to work and play! 

Keen to be part of the vibrant SMU community? Kickstart your journey with SMU at http://bit.ly/smuadmissions-campustour2020

title: University of British Columbia UBC Okanagan Campus Tour
description:
Explore the stunning University of British Columbia Okanagan campus with Madison and Alqeshira from the Engineering Stories team! Get ready to be amazed by our 209-hectare campus, as we take you on a tour filled with exciting highlights.

Recorded in Spring 2024. Please note all information provided was factual at the time of posting but may have since changed.
